#SJSharks Filip Bystedt on making his NHL debut: 

"It was awesome. Exactly how you dream it to be. Good day."
What a play by Bystedt on his first rush! Breaks down the wing, blows by Buium and gets to the front but was stoppped by Merilainen. #SJSharks

Filip Bystedt will make his NHL debut as the #SJSharks host the #Canucks this evening. Read what Warsofsky said about that and more on Sharks Hockey Digest.
